note: Golden questions for the grounded chat (WS-41). Run offline with `python scripts/eval_chat.py`; every case is answered by the deterministic fallback, so the pass/fail is about grounding, refusal and number extraction — not about a model's prose. `must_mention` phrases are checked case-insensitively.

cases.question: What is the margin per kg right now?
What is the current salmon export price?
How old is the feed cost data?
When was the newest chlorophyll observation?
Is there an algal bloom right now?
What is the average lice level by production area?
What lice limit applies to a site this week?
cases.note: WS-45: unbound questions must not quote a single limit — the answer has to say it depends on the site's production area and spring window. The matrix lives in tests/test_lice_limit_binding.py.
